# Erdos.p617 — Erdős problem 617

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/617
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/617.lean`, theorem `erdos_617`, AMS 5).

Let $r\geq 3$. If the edges of $K_{r^2+1}$ are $r$-coloured then there exist $r+1$ vertices with at
least one colour missing on the edges of the induced $K_{r+1}$.

In other words, there is no balanced colouring.

A conjecture of Erdős and Gyárfás [ErGy99].

## Statement
∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : r ≥ 3) {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (hV : Fintype.card V = r^2 + 1) (coloring : Sym2 V → Fin r), ∃ (S : Finset V) (k : Fin r),
      S.card = r + 1 ∧
      ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ v ∈ S, u ≠ v → coloring s(u, v) ≠ k

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
